pro_course_detail.title: Basic Shona phrases
pro_course_detail.description:
Shona: Tichange tichidzidza kuti tinotaura sei nerurimi rwechiShona. Izvi zvinobatsira kune avo vachange vachida kushanya munyika yeZimbabwe. Kunyangwe chirungu uri mutauro unoshandiswa zvakanyanya muZimbabwe, ruzhinji rwevanhu runoshandisa Shona semutauro wavo. Zvinogona kutora nguva kudzidza chiShona asi zvinobatsira zvikuru kudzidza kuti ukwanise kutaura neruzhinji rwevanhu vemuZimbabwe. 
English: We will be learning some helpful Shona words and phrases that can be of practical help when you are going around the country. While English is widely spoken, there is a large majority that speaks the other official language of Zimbabwe, which is called Shona. It can take some effort to get used to, but if you take the time to learn a few words, it will help you to understand the locals better.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice in Shona
pro_course_detail.description:
Shona: Chidzidzo ichi chinovavarira kuvandudza ruzivo rwekutaura narwo mutauro weShona kuburikidza nekuita hurukuro nerurimi rwechiShona. 

English: This lesson aims to develop one's communicative competence in Shona by having conversations in that language. Conversation practice helps one to improve significantly in their overall fluidity of speech, variation in vocabulary, listening comprehension, and correct use of grammar.

pro_course_detail.title: Shona Grammar
pro_course_detail.description:
